content.stem: 一名反洗钱合规官收到了一份独立审计报告，其中包含若干发现。对这份报告的恰当回应应包括:

options.A: 起草详细的行动计划，供审计团队执行，以完成审计发现的整改
options.B: 重新对审计发现中提及的控制措施进行测试，以确认审计结果
options.C: 根据审计发现的根本原因分析来确定补救措施
options.D: 将审查行动计划的责任分配给董事会

content.stem_en: An AML compliance officer receives an independent audit report with a number of findings. An appropriate response to the report would include:

options_en.A: Drafting detailed action plans for the audit team to execute to close the findings
options_en.B: Reperforming the testing for the controls mentioned in the findings to confirm the results of the audit
options_en.C: Defining remedial actions based on the findings' root cause analysis
options_en.D: Assigning responsibility for reviewing the action plan to the board of directors
